title: Fleet: readable trip labels, working availability/top drivers, trip type + lead prefill, human timeline
goal: The fleet dashboard tells trips apart and reflects real availability; trips have a type and can be booked from a lead; the trip timeline uses human labels.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Verified: fleet/page.tsx:260,395,417 label trips with trip.id.slice(0,8) - UUIDv7 prefixes are time-based so all read "Trip #01a100b2"; "No drivers available" with 3 active drivers (B12 fixed/ documented the top-drivers endpoint); availability grid used the shadowed /fleet/vehicles/availability (fixed in B12); dates raw ISO. Backend trips have trip_type (default one_way; enum in backend/src/routes/fleet.ts trip schema ~1190-1280 and the rate-card lookup uses tripType e.g. airport_pickup) - the desktop trip form has no "Trip type" select (FR-7). Contract from B20: /fleet/trips/new?leadId=<id>&tripType=airport_pickup must prefill lead and trip type. Trip detail timeline shows raw keys like "check_in" (FR-8). fleet/vehicles/[id] has raw date inputs (BUG-058 part). components/domain/fleet/{driver-schedule-calendar.tsx, trip-format.ts}. W6 RULES: you run in parallel with 11 other page batches in separate worktrees - touch ONLY your allowlist; never edit lint-baseline.json (the orchestrator ratchets it after merge); shared-file needs go to desktop/audit/fix/requests/<BATCH_ID>.md.
steps: Fleet dashboard: trip labels = passenger name + local pickup time (or a human trip number if the API has one); dates via formatDisplayDate/time; Top Drivers from the endpoint B12 documented; availability grid from /fleet/vehicles/availability.

Trip form (trips/new + [id]/edit): "Trip type" Select with labelled backend enum values ("Airport pickup", "Airport drop", "One way", "Round trip", ...); prefillFromParams {leadId -> lead, tripType -> tripType}; when vehicle type + trip type are set call the rate-card lookup to suggest the fare.

Trip detail timeline (FR-8): map status/event keys to labels (assigned "Assigned", accepted "Accepted", rejected "Rejected", en_route "En route", check_in "Checked in", started "Trip started", check_out "Checked out", completed "Completed", cancelled "Cancelled"), en-IN times, and coordinates when present. Put the map in components/domain/fleet/trip-format.ts.
Drivers/vehicles/rate-cards/alerts pages and driver-schedule-calendar swept; vehicles/[id] dates -> DatePicker.

CONTRACT SWEEP on every non-spec file in your allowlist (do this while fixing the bugs above, file by file): (a) `node scripts/lint-gate.mjs --zero <your allowlist globs>` must report 0 errors in your files: replace `any` with real types imported from desktop/src/lib/api/*, delete unused vars/imports, remove raw hex/rgb/px literals and raw Tailwind palette classes. Token map: gray/slate text -> text-ds-foreground / text-ds-foreground-muted / text-ds-foreground-subtle; gray backgrounds -> bg-ds-surface / bg-ds-surface-sunken / bg-ds-surface-raised; borders -> border-ds-border / border-ds-border-strong; green/emerald -> ds-success (+ -subtle bg, -on-subtle text); red/rose -> ds-danger; amber/yellow/orange -> ds-warning; blue/sky/cyan -> ds-info; indigo/violet/purple/orange-as-brand/primary-NNN -> ds-primary; chart colours -> ds-chart-1..6 or useThemeTokens(); arbitrary px (text-[13px], w-[240px], h-[600px]) -> Tailwind scale (text-sm, w-60) or ds spacing (p-ds-4, gap-ds-2).

LAYOUT: every page root uses an archetype (ListPage / EntityForm / DetailPage) or `<PageContainer>` from @/components/layout/page-container with a PageHeader (title + description + actions). Remove ad-hoc root padding (p-6, px-8, container mx-auto) and any page-level scroll wrapper (`h-full overflow-auto`, `flex-1 overflow-y-auto`) - <main> is the only page scroller; tables scroll inside DataTable's data-scroll-region (BUG-048 contribution).

FIELDS: native `<input type="date">` -> DatePicker (+ toLocalDateString / parseLocalDate from @/lib/dates); money `type="number"` inputs -> CurrencyInput; any id/relation text input -> RelationCombobox (with resolveSelected for edit forms); phone -> PhoneInput; `window.confirm` / bare `confirm(` -> `useConfirm()` from @/components/ui; `toLocaleDateString()` / `toLocaleString()` without a locale -> formatDisplayDate from @/lib/dates (en-IN); no mailto:/wa.me/tel: (SendMessageDialog). Icon-only buttons get an aria-label. Never two elements with the same id on one page.

PROBE: with your stack slot up, run `node scripts/layout-probe.mjs --routes /fleet,/fleet/trips,/fleet/trips/new,/fleet/trips/<tripId>,/fleet/drivers,/fleet/drivers/new,/fleet/drivers/<driverId>,/fleet/vehicles,/fleet/vehicles/<vehicleId>,/fleet/rate-cards,/fleet/alerts --viewports 1366x768,1920x1080 --themes light,dark --out audit/fix/probe/<BATCH_ID>` (replace <id> placeholders with real seeded ids from the API) and fix every failure (gutter, horizontal overflow, nested scroller, console/page error, blank top-bar title). Attach probe.json summary to your report.

SPECS: run the specs listed in gates.specs; fix app regressions. If a spec asserts behaviour this batch intentionally changed, update that spec (spec files in your allowlist only). Pre-existing failures that belong to another batch: list them in your report, do not chase them.

If you need a change in a shared file you may not touch (ui primitives, archetypes, client, globals, helpers), do NOT edit it: write the request to desktop/audit/fix/requests/<BATCH_ID>.md (file per batch, so parallel merges never conflict) and work around locally where possible. B30 consumes these requests.
mustNotTouch: any file owned by another W6 batch (see FIX-PLAN.md section 6 ownership table)
acceptance: Fleet dashboard trip labels are distinct and human.
notes: fleet-drivers.spec.ts was updated by B16 - edit only if your change requires.
